name: 相连路网批量升级 | Connected Network Upgrade
summary: Preview and upgrade all connected roads or tracks using the selected upgrade tool.
description: Adds a Whole connected network switch to road and track upgrade tools. Select a segment, review counts and estimated costs, then confirm. Supports road and track types, electrification, bus lanes, tram tracks, road development locking and edge decorations. Traverses branches, bridges and tunnels; skips locked construction segments and rejected upgrades. Uses normal construction costs. Cancel stops remaining work. Existing upgrades remain when this mod is removed. Restart the game after installation. Revision 5 has not been verified in game. Cover art is an AI-generated concept illustration, not a gameplay screenshot.

zh_CN.name: 相连路网批量升级
zh_CN.summary: 按当前选择，预览并升级整个相连公路或铁路网络。
zh_CN.description: 在道路和铁路升级工具中增加“整个相连路网”开关。点击一段路，查看数量与预计费用，再确认执行。支持公路与轨道类型、电气化、公交专用道、有轨电车轨道、道路发展锁定及路段边缘设施。遍历岔路、桥梁和隧道；跳过建筑锁定和引擎拒绝的路段，正常计费。取消停止剩余任务，卸载保留已完成升级。安装后完全退出并重启游戏。revision 5 未游戏内验证。 封面为 AI 生成的功能示意插画，非游戏实机截图。
